span.p: [D3] Dynamic diagram: legacy down or file missing

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
1. No file from legacy:
alert, nothing else waits

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
7. Guest checked out:
cleaning starts as usual

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
8. Legacy back: next numbered
file catches up

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
9. Idempotent import: same
file twice changes nothing

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Views room photos and
descriptions; books a room
type or a specific room on
web or mobile.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Front desk (phone and walk-in
bookings with a payment link,
check-in / out), hotel
manager (replacement rooms),
housekeeping supervisor (cart
queues).

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Room photos and descriptions,
availability; books a room
type or a specific room;
sends the guest to the
payment operator's page.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Phone and walk-in bookings on
the same path as guests
(phone: the guest gets a
payment link), check-in /
out, room board, cart queue
panel.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Board frame Rezerwacja + room
availability and status: the
only place that can take a
room for a night (one
transaction); holds the room
10 min while the guest
pre-authorises the payment at
the payment operator,
confirmed by webhook; never
waits for legacy; computes
when every hotel room is
needed next.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Board frames Housekeeping +
Servis tech: one queue for
cleaning and repairs,
priority from when the room
is needed next; API for cart
devices. Keeps its own copy
of room status and room
needed-by (events from
Rezerwacje), so it works on
the last known state while
Rezerwacje is down.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Board frames Visit + Faraway:
check-in, checkout,
replacement room, room
complaints; keeps its own
copy of today's arrivals and
room status (events from
Rezerwacje) and builds the
reception emergency list from
it every 15 min (file +
e-mail); smart-lock adapter:
lock-to-room mapping, issues
and revokes mobile keys
(guest: check-in to checkout;
housekeeper: assigned room,
for the task).

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Board frame Synchronizacja:
the only place that swaps
files with legacy, both ways
every 15 min. In: room pool
we may sell, prices, non-pool
bookings, check-ins and
check-outs. Out: our pool
bookings with guest data,
check-ins / outs, payment
pre-authorisation number.
Numbered files, idempotent
import, alert on a missing
file; nightly full comparison
(pool: we win, non-pool:
legacy wins).

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Existing system: non-pool
reservations, prices, stay
settlement and refunds at
checkout, cancellations,
manager reports. No API, only
file exchange. Blocks a room
pool that only we sell.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
External payment operator:
hosted payment page, card
pre-authorisation at booking.
We never see card data.
